original_evidence.text: | simple64 | github.com/simple64/simple64 (+ github.com/simple64/simple64-updater) | Qt desktop GUI wrapping Mupen64Plus | Y | **auto chk** (background check via `QNetworkAccessManager` on the GitHub Releases API, disable-able via `SIMPLE64_DISABLE_UPDATER` env var, Windows/Linux only — `#ifndef __APPLE__`) + user confirms Yes/No, then **auto dl/inst**: once confirmed, no further prompts | Y — downloads a separate native executable `simple64-updater`/`simple64-updater.exe` from GitHub Releases, writes it to a `QTemporaryDir`, `chmod`s it executable (`ReadOwner\|WriteOwner\|ExeOwner`), and launches it detached (`QProcess::startDetached`) while the main app quits;
